backend/main.mo: Actor canister implementing crop yield prediction, plant disease detection, and irrigation recommendation with access control and per‑user history storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test requirements with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text index summarizing the purpose of each frontend file including pages, components, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and custom theme variables defining the app’s color system for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Frontend README explaining project overview, modules, and setup requirements.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes and wrapping content with ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AppAlert.tsx: Reusable alert component showing error, success, or info messages with icons.
frontend/src/components/AppNav.tsx: Top navigation bar with module links, logo, and login state indicator.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Wrapper that blocks access to authenticated features and prompts login when needed.
frontend/src/components/FormField.tsx: Shared input/select form field component with labels, validation, and consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/HistorySection.t: Reusable authenticated history section with clear button and item rendering.
frontend/src/components/ImageUploadField: Image upload input with preview, validation, and clear controls.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Empty placeholder file for a profile setup modal component.
frontend/src/components/ThemeCard.tsx: Card wrapper component with optional title and description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCropYieldPredictio: Mutation hook to call crop yield prediction and refresh related history.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiseaseDetection.t: Mutation hook for plant disease detection that uploads image bytes and refreshes history.
frontend/src/hooks/useHistoryQueries.ts: Query and mutation hooks for fetching and clearing crop, disease, and irrigation histories.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, state, and persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useIrrigationRecommen: Mutation hook for irrigation recommendation and history refresh.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Empty placeholder file for a user profile hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for themes and layout.
frontend/src/layouts/AppLayout.tsx: Main application layout with navigation, outlet, and footer.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint setting up React Query, Internet Identity, and rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/CropYieldPage.tsx: Page for entering soil and weather inputs, validating them, submitting to a crop-yield prediction API, and displaying results with a small bar chart and history.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Landing dashboard listing navigation cards for major modules with a hero section and quick links.
Page for uploading a leaf image, validating it, sending it to a disease‑detection API, and showing detection results and history.
frontend/src/pages/IrrigationPage.tsx: Form-driven page that validates soil and weather inputs, fetches irrigation recommendations, and displays results with history.
frontend/src/pages/VisualizationsPage.ts: Analytics dashboard compiling crop, disease, and irrigation history into charts, gated behind authentication.
frontend/src/utils/fileToUint8Array.ts: Utility that reads a File into an ArrayBuffer and returns it as a Uint8Array.
frontend/src/utils/formatErrorMessage.ts: Utility that normalizes error messages, including special handling for auth and validation errors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and manipulating hash-based query parameters.
frontend/src/utils/validation.ts: Defines validation functions for crop yield and irrigation inputs and checks uploaded image type and size.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, components, animations, and registering typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Stores overall project metadata including architecture notes, features, requirements, and image needs.
